exposure: Women with placenta accreta who underwent hysterectomies
Women with placenta accreta whose deliveries did not result in hysterectomy
outcome: Maternal plasma human placental lactogen (hPL) mRNA levels
cohort: 68 singleton pregnant women with prior Cesarean deliveries.
finding: Maternal plasma hPL mRNA levels were significantly higher in women with placenta accreta compared to those with normal placentation or placenta previa alone, suggesting that hPL mRNA may indicate abnormally invasive placenta.
